_comment: Built-in SkyBlock simulator scenarios (/hollow sbsim <name>). Generated from the unit-test fixtures.

scenarios.name: hub
scenarios.description: Joins SkyBlock in the Hub: scoreboard, tab list, profile, purse changes, a rare drop and skill XP

scenarios.name: garden
scenarios.description: The Garden: copper, three visitors, Farming XP

scenarios.name: slayer
scenarios.description: A Sven Packmaster IV quest in the Park: progress, your boss spawns (a frozen wolf with its name tags), quest complete, a drop

scenarios.name: mining
scenarios.description: Dwarven Mines: commissions (one finishes), powder going up, the forge, a mining event, Cold, a pickaxe ability and the Sky Mall buff

scenarios.name: crystal_hollows
scenarios.description: Crystal Hollows: crystals found, Heat, and metal detector readings from six spots (you're moved around; the treasure is 3 blocks under a spot near you)

scenarios.name: fishing
scenarios.description: Lava fishing on the Crimson Isle: sea creatures near you, a Thunder and a Lord Jawbus, a double hook, two trophy fish and the sea creature cap

scenarios.name: galatea
scenarios.description: Hunting on Galatea: two Huntraps placed, then both catch something

scenarios.name: crimson
scenarios.description: Crimson Isle: a Vanquisher's name tag nearby, and the Faction Quests and Reputation widgets (an illustrative layout) for the Tab Widgets HUD

scenarios.name: diana
scenarios.description: Diana's Mythological Ritual in the Hub: two burrows of a six-burrow chain, then a Minos Inquisitor's name tag nearby

scenarios.name: dungeon
scenarios.description: Catacombs F7: cleared percent, secrets, a boss line and the score

scenarios.name: rift
scenarios.description: The Rift: motes going up and the time left running low (the one-minute warning)

scenarios.name: general
scenarios.description: General area: status bars from the action bar, your pet, a power orb and a big damage number nearby, a fairy soul

scenarios.name: economy
scenarios.description: Bazaar orders set up and filled, an auction sold, a growing purse

scenarios.name: items
scenarios.description: Gives a Hyperion, a Golden Dragon pet, an Ultimate Wise book and a drill, and opens a menu with them
